messages:
anna-support: Novum Labs says onboarding flow completed but no API key shows up in their project. Console shows "provisioner: success". Customer blocked on integration. Can someone triage?
ben-devex: filing here — can you paste tenant ID + any request IDs from the UI? Also did they use SSO/OIDC?
anna-support: tenant=novum-123, request id=req_0a9f3c. They used SSO via Okta. UI trace: "provisioner: success, key surfaced to org but not to project".
deploy-bot: [provisioner-job/novum-123] finished 2025-10-11T15:04:22Z status=0 pid=8421
ben-devex: this smells like the service-role binding propagation race. Can you grab the provisioner logs around that req id?
carlos-eng: +1. If the provisioner returns success before IAM sync finishes the key may land in the org but not be bound to the customer project. Quick check: run the reconcile script or re-run provisioner job.
anna-support: pasting minimal log snippet:
```
2025-10-11T15:04:20Z INFO provisioner: creating service-account svc-novum-123
2025-10-11T15:04:21Z INFO iam: binding role service-role to svc-novum-123 in project novum-prod
2025-10-11T15:04:21Z INFO provisioner: created api-key apikey_abc123
2025-10-11T15:04:21Z INFO provisioner: success (request=req_0a9f3c)
2025-10-11T15:04:21Z WARN iam: role-binding not visible via cache yet
```
ben-devex: yep. Looks like we created the key then returned success. Customer consoles query the cache which lags. Two options: manual bind+resync for this tenant, or run a forced reconcile. Try: `./scripts/reconcile_creds --tenant novum-123 --force`
anna-support: ran reconcile, output:
```
$ ./scripts/reconcile_creds --tenant novum-123 --force
2025-10-11T15:06:05Z INFO fetch tenant novum-123
2025-10-11T15:06:06Z ERROR iam: get-service-account svc-novum-123 403 Forbidden
```
carlos-eng: 403 on the service account lookup — that suggests the provisioner created the SA in the control plane but the projected IAM principal wasn't propagated to the cloud account. Can @dana-oncall check the cloud-iam sync logs?
dana-oncall: looking. I see a backfill job failed at 15:04:22 for novum-123 due to transient permission error talking to partner-connector (502). That explains the 403. I'll trigger a backfill and also grant a manual binding so customer can proceed.
anna-support: thanks — customer confirmed they can now see the key in their project after you did the manual bind. They tested a simple call and got 200.
dana-oncall: root cause: transient partner-connector 502 caused IAM sync to skip binding step while provisioner completed. Action items: 1) add retry/poll in provisioner before returning success (JIRA REDWOOD-4281), 2) improve backfill alerting when partner-connector returns 5xx, 3) run a one-time sweep to reconcile org-created keys not bound to projects last 24h.
carlos-eng: I'll own the provisioner change. Created branch and draft PR.
ben-devex: docs note: update runbook at https://confluence/redwood/onboard-provisioning-runbook with the manual bind steps and the reconcile script example.
anna-support: closing for now — marking as customer-resolved. Will follow up with postmortem once REDWOOD-4281 is in. :thumbsup:
